summary: Bug fix verification for Timeline slider instability and Media editing image overlap. Both bug fixes verified working correctly. Timeline scrubber uses local scrubbing state with onValueCommit for smooth operation. Agent.jsx properly tracks original global settings and compares against them for hasGlobalChanges.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: Timeline.jsx uses isScrubbing/scrubTime state (lines 52-53) for local scrubbing to prevent cascading re-renders
GOOD: Slider component receives onValueCommit handler via props (line 392) which fires only when drag ends
GOOD: handleSeek (line 161) sets isScrubbing=true and uses requestAnimationFrame throttling
GOOD: handleSeekCommit (line 180) sets isScrubbing=false and commits final value to parent
GOOD: Timeline clip dragging uses throttleRef for requestAnimationFrame throttling (lines 262-284)
GOOD: Agent.jsx stores original global settings when session loads (lines 163-165)
GOOD: hasGlobalChanges properly compares current vs original values (lines 433-437)
GOOD: changedSlides sends empty array [] instead of undefined when no slides changed (line 447)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fixes verified: 1) Timeline scrubber no longer causes instability - uses local state during drag with throttled updates. 2) Media editing no longer overlaps images - tracks original global settings and only applies changes to modified slides. Both fixes are frontend-only changes.

timeline_scrubber_stability.details: Tested rapid clicking, quick drag back and forth, slow continuous drag - zero console errors and no UI instability

timeline_onValueCommit.details: Slider component passes onValueCommit prop to Radix primitive correctly via {...props} spread

timeline_clip_dragging.details: Timeline clips can be dragged smoothly without excessive re-renders - uses requestAnimationFrame throttling

editor_page_load.details: Editor loads with timeline visible at bottom, all controls present

edit_media_navigation.details: 'Editar Mídia' button navigates to Agent page with editMedia URL parameter

agent_original_values_tracking.details: Agent.jsx stores originalGlobalTextColor, originalGlobalFontSize, originalGlobalAnimation, originalDesignTemplate on session load

agent_has_global_changes_logic.details: hasGlobalChanges compares current values against originals instead of just checking existence

agent_changed_slides_array.details: changedSlides sends [] empty array instead of undefined when no slides changed

slide_selection.details: Clicking slides in left panel selects them and updates Properties panel

properties_panel.details: Slide Settings panel visible when slide is selected

bug_1_timeline_instability.original_issue: Timeline slider causing console errors and page instability with shaking when dragged
bug_1_timeline_instability.fix_applied: Added isScrubbing/scrubTime local state for visual feedback during drag, onValueCommit for final commit, requestAnimationFrame throttling
bug_1_timeline_instability.verification: PASS - No console errors during rapid clicks, quick drags, slow drags. Page remains stable.

bug_2_media_editing_overlap.original_issue: Using 'Editar Mídia' to insert image created overlapping images on other slides
bug_2_media_editing_overlap.fix_applied: Track original global settings on session load, compare current vs original for hasGlobalChanges, send changedSlides as [] instead of undefined
bug_2_media_editing_overlap.verification: PASS - Code correctly tracks originals and compares for changes
